date_in_force.why: Rests on a committee analysis describing section 3111 as existing law with the 1 Jan 2026 deadline (alt-official); the statute text is not stored.

summary_claims.claim: Developers must post a high-level summary of training data, including whether it includes copyright, trademark or patent protected data or is entirely public domain
Posting due on or before 1 Jan 2026 for systems released on or after 1 Jan 2022

note: Title, chaptering on 28 Sep 2024 as Chapter 817 and the compliance date are supported by the Assembly Weekly History and a Senate committee analysis. The Governor release is labelled alt-official, as it should be. No amendment of Civil Code 3110-3111 turned up in one targeted search; the statute text is still not stored.
